stem: Which statement about the number 34 is true?

options.label: F
options.text: It is odd, because the digit in the tens place is odd.

options.label: G
options.text: It is even, because the digit in the tens place is even.

options.label: H
options.text: It is odd, because it can be divided by 3 evenly.

options.label: J
options.text: It is even, because it can be divided by 2 evenly.

difficulty_rationale: The question requires direct knowledge of odd/even properties and understanding place value, which is a straightforward recall task for grade 3.
